data.title: 伊地知虹夏 · 晨光阳台的被单捉迷藏
data.description: 晴空万里的清晨阳台上，微风扬起刚刚洗净的白床单。虹夏躲在纯白的棉布被单后，双手探出拉开一道缝隙，露出明媚耀眼的笑颜。阳光穿透薄薄的被单为她整个人镀上一圈金色绒边，宛如真正降临凡间的大天使。
data.action: 阳光穿透薄薄的被单为她整个人镀上一圈金色绒边，宛如真正降临凡间的大天使
data.promptProse: Peeking playfully from behind freshly washed white bedsheets hanging in the morning sun on the balcony, Ijichi Nijika beams like a true angel. Golden sunbeams backlight her blonde hair and signature dorito ahoge as she giggles warmly.
data.animaCaption: Nijika peeking playfully behind fresh white bedsheets on a sunny balcony.
